SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in an IPv6 literal

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "crawlberg.h"

#ifndef ALEF_TEST_PASS
#define ALEF_TEST_PASS() do { return EXIT_SUCCESS; } while (0)
#endif

int main(void) {
    CBERGAlefHandle config_handle = cberg_crawl_config_from_json("{\"ssrf\":{\"deny_private\":true},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}");
    if (config_handle == 0) { ALEF_TEST_PASS(); }
    CBERGAlefHandle engine = cberg_create_engine(config_handle);
    cberg_crawl_config_free(config_handle);
    if (engine == 0) { ALEF_TEST_PASS(); }
    char url[2048];
    snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s", "http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/");
    CBERGAlefHandle result = cberg_scrape(engine, url);
    if (result != 0) cberg_scrape_result_free(result);
    cberg_crawl_engine_handle_free(engine);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
